title: Book Three · Chapter 94: Half Past Eight
story:
On Tuesday, the man with the travel books comes back.

He introduces himself as Mr Wei. His relatives want books for their children. He needs six, with pictures and complete stories.

Ronan brings the two new travel books to the doorway. Leo finds four illustrated stories from the last bought pile.

“These?” Ronan asks.

Mr Wei opens the first one. He likes the clear pictures and the large words.

“All complete?”

“We will check every page,” Ronan says.

“Two yuan each?”

“Yes. Twelve for six.”

Mr Wei nods. He has a family visit on Saturday. He wants to collect the books early, before the table opens.

“Half past eight?” he asks.

Ronan looks toward his notebook inside the room.

At half past eight, he planned to leave for Anna. The library is twenty minutes away on foot. A quick handover could still leave time before nine.

“Leo can give them to you,” he starts.

Mr Wei smiles at him.

“You showed me the first books very clearly. I would like to ask about these too.”

Ronan feels pleased. He takes the six books into his hands.

“I can be here for a few minutes.”

Leo looks up. Mr Wei is already taking a small paper from his pocket.

He writes his name and home address. Payment will be on Saturday. He leaves without taking any books today.

Ronan puts the six together. All have B inside their back covers. All came from the eight they bought yesterday.

The other fifteen books stay on the shelf.

After Mr Wei leaves, Leo points to Anna's morning.

“You said half past eight.”

“He can come at half past. Five minutes, then I go.”

“I can explain the books.”

“He asked me.”

Leo watches him for a moment. Then he nods.

“Don't make another long morning.”

Ronan writes Mr Wei beside half past eight. Beneath it, he keeps Library, nine. There is only a short space between the two lines.

Mum comes in with a finished sleeve. She asks about the six books on the table.

“An order,” Ronan says.

“Paid?”

“Saturday.”

She gives him room for the pile and takes her cloth to the window. Ronan opens the first story. He starts with the page numbers, then turns back to the pictures.

Outside, a customer stops at Mr Qiu's stall. Ronan looks up at the voice. He wonders how many more people will come to the book table on Saturday.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

illustrated＝配有插图的；complete＝完整的；handover＝交接；payment＝付款。

## 理解问题

1. Mr Wei新订几本、总价多少、什么时候取？这时有没有已付钱或取走书？
2. Ronan为什么又答应亲自留下？Leo是否已经提出可以代交？

## 读句子

**The other fifteen books stay on the shelf.**

拆开看：The other fifteen books / stay / on the shelf.

另外十五本书／仍放着／放在架上。
